name: pretty-math
description: Renders the math expression under your cursor as real two-dimensional math in a panel, so precedence and grouping mistakes are obvious.

prettyMath.autoUpdate.description: Re-render automatically as the cursor moves or the selection changes.

prettyMath.fontSize.description: Base font size (px) of the rendered math.

prettyMath.caretMeansPower.markdownDescription: How to read `^`. `auto` uses the language: power in MATLAB/Julia/R/Lua/Fortran, bitwise XOR in C/C++/C#/Java/JavaScript/Python/Rust/Go.

prettyMath.multiplication.markdownDescription: How to draw `*`. `implicit` juxtaposes factors (a dot is still inserted where it would be ambiguous).

prettyMath.indexAsSubscript.markdownDescription: Render `a[i]` as a subscript rather than with brackets.

prettyMath.greekLetters.markdownDescription: Render identifiers named after Greek letters (`theta`, `omega`, `dt_alpha`, ...) as the letter itself.

prettyMath.expandIdentities.markdownDescription: Expand a few library calls into the math they stand for: `hypot(a,b)` as a root, `log1p(x)` as ln(1+x), `expm1(x)` as e^x-1, `exp(x)` as e^x.

prettyMath.derivativeSymbol.markdownDescription: The symbol used for a derivative. `auto` writes `d` for a single variable and `∂` when several are differentiated.

prettyMath.stripNamespaces.markdownDescription: Qualifiers dropped before rendering, so `np.sqrt(x)` reads as a plain root and `self.mass` as `mass`.

prettyMath.showLatex.description: Show the LaTeX source underneath the rendered math.

prettyMath.showTree.description: Show the parse tree underneath the rendered math.

prettyMath.maxLines.description: Maximum number of statements rendered from a multi-line selection.

scripts.test: node test/run.js && node test/host.js && node test/corpus.js
